response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS tp, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS al FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(tp) AS avgtp FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.tp) AS total_points, AVG(t.al) AS avg_laps, AVG(t.tp - a.avgtp) AS avg_excess FROM t, a WHERE t.tp > a.avgtp
